 Advertisement Bob Mills, well-known founder of popular Oklahoma furniture store, dies at 79
 Advertisement Updated: 12:01 PM CST Nov 9, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jonathan Greco Digital Media Manager Bob Mills, well-known founder of popular Oklahoma furniture store, dies at 79
 Updated: 12:01 PM CST Nov 9, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jonathan Greco Digital Media Manager OKLAHOMA CITY — Bob Mills, the well-known founder of Bob Mills Furniture, has died at the age of 79, his family announced on Monday. 
 >> Open the video player above to see some of the headlines KOCO 5 is following. 
 Advertisement 
 "It is with heavy hearts and profound sadness that we share the passing of our beloved husband, father, and founder of Bob Mills Furniture, Bob Mills," his family posted on Facebook . "For our family, this is an immeasurable loss. But we also know that his passing will be felt by the countless people whose lives he touched throughout the years." 
 The cause of death is unknown. Funeral and memorial service arrangements have not been determined as of Monday morning. 
 "On behalf of our entire family, thank you for being part of his journey and for helping carry forward something that meant so much to him," Mills' family said in the Facebook post. "We ask that you keep our family in your thoughts and prayers during this difficult time." 
 Mills opened his first furniture store in Oklahoma City when he was 23 years old and shortly after he graduated from college. The company grew in the late 1980s, and there are nine other stores across Oklahoma and Texas. 
 Bob Mills' Family Statement 
 To Friends and Family, It is with heavy hearts and profound sadness that we share the passing of our beloved husband, father, and founder of Bob Mills Furniture, Bob Mills. For our family, this is an immeasurable loss. But we also know that his passing will be felt by the countless people whose lives he touched throughout the years. Bob built more than a furniture company. He built a legacy rooted in hard work, determination, relationships, and a genuine belief in people. What began as his dream grew into something far greater than he could have imagined, and each of you has played a part in making that possible. He was incredibly proud of this company, but even more importantly, he was proud of the people who made it what it is today. As his family, we want you to know how deeply grateful we are for your dedication, loyalty, and the role you have played in his life’s work. You are part of his legacy, and that is something we will always cherish. We also want to reassure each of you that Bob Mills Furniture will continue to move forward. The company he worked so hard to build will continue to operate, guided by the same values, dedication, and commitment to excellence that have defined it for so many years. We remain committed to honoring his vision and carrying his legacy into the future. At this time, funeral and memorial service arrangements have not yet been determined. We will share those details as soon as they become available. On behalf of our entire family, thank you for being part of his journey and for helping carry forward something that meant so much to him. We ask that you keep our family in your thoughts and prayers during this difficult time.
